rulesScope: Current English Ravensburger tournament rules; not Japanese regional policy or a guarantee of event-specific eligibility
identityRule: Full English card name including character/location version; case-insensitive; Unicode NFC and whitespace normalization; typographic apostrophes equivalent; retain all other punctuation and never fuzzy-match or drop version. Gameplay rules text can differ through errata without creating a distinct named card.
algorithm: Reject explicitly special-format-only records before matching names.
An unverified future numeric set or an unknown nonnumeric set returns unknown; never autoallow every set >=9.
Seed eligible gameplay identities from verified released sets9–14, after explicit ban list application.
A printing from a known regular or promo group matching an eligible full identity is legal even if its printed set rotated or its rarity/finish differs.
A known regular/promo printing matched only to rotated-set identities is not_legal with reason rotated; it is not called banned.
Any unresolved identity is unknown and omitted by an Only Core Legal filter.
Retain source/date and legal anchor. Do not overwrite source-provider lc/legalities; they are stale observations, not the adjudicating source.
futurePolicy: No future rotation or ban forecast. Review current official resources when policy changes; expose last-verified date. Sets absent from this finite policy remain unknown.
deckValidationCaveat: Card-pool filter alone does not validate a whole deck: minimum60 cards, at most2 ink types, and full-identity copy limits plus card-text exceptions must be checked separately.
